chunks: And in the narration of ʿAmr ibn Shimr, from Jaʿfar ibn Ghālib al-Asadī, who raised the hadith, he said:

While two men were sitting in the time of ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, a man in chains passed by them. One of the two men said, “If there is not such-and-such in his chain, then his wife is divorced three times.” The other said, “If there is in it as you said, then his wife is divorced three times.”

So they went to the master of the slave, who was the one chained, and said to him, “We have sworn regarding such-and-such, so loosen the chain of your غلام so that we may weigh it.” The master of the slave said, “My wife is divorced if I loosen the chain of my غلام.”

Then they brought the matter to ʿUmar and related the story to him. ʿUmar said, “His master has more right over him. Take him to ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib; perhaps he may have something concerning this matter.”

So they came to ʿAlī عليه السلام and told him the story. He said, “How easy this is.” Then he called for a large basin and ordered that a string be tied to the chain. He put the man’s feet and the chain into the basin, then poured water over it until it was full.

Then he عليه السلام said, “Lift the chain.” So they lifted the chain until it was brought out of the water, and when it was taken out, the water decreased. Then he called for pieces of iron and cast them into the water until the water returned to its place while the chain was in the water. Then he said, “Weigh this iron; it is its weight.”

key_terms.الْقِصَّةَ: the account or story of the case

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام determine the weight of a chain without removing it in a legal dispute?
ai.summary: This report narrates a case brought before Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام involving conflicting divorce oaths tied to the weight of a chain that could not be removed. Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام resolved the matter through a practical method using water displacement and iron pieces to determine the chain’s weight. The narration highlights his knowledge and judicial resourcefulness in resolving difficult disputes.
